why: We want AI to take paperwork off your plate. We also want to protect the people we serve and keep errors from going out under our name.
who_it_covers: All staff, volunteers, contractors and board members.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot (pilot)
tools.approved_for: Pilot licenses only (development team and operations manager); no protected information.

tools.name: No other AI tools
tools.approved_for: No other AI tool is approved yet.

new_tools: Luis approves any new tool, plugin, agent or AI feature in software we own, checking what data it sees. If it touches client data, Grace, our privacy officer, also approves.
accounts: Use your work account, and turn off any setting that lets the vendor train on what you type.
allowed_uses: Draft thank-you letters in Copilot (pilot users).
Summarize grant guidelines in Copilot (pilot users).

needs_approval.use: New tool, plugin, agent or AI feature
Any new tool that touches client data

protected_information: Case files: family names, addresses, income, immigration status, children's names, domestic violence, mental health and substance use notes (county contract). Donor names, giving history, major-gift notes. Student names, test scores, immigration status. Tutoring kids' names, grades, attendance (district agreement). Staff HR files. Passwords and logins.
off_limits: Browser plugins that read your email.
Passing off AI-made images as real families or clients.
AI writing public statements about the news. A person writes them.
check_before_it_goes_out: A person checks everything AI helps write: facts, names, numbers, tone and bias.
Check every number against its source, especially county and funder reports. You own what you send.
decisions_about_people: AI never decides who gets emergency assistance funds. Caseworkers decide with their supervisor.
AI does not decide who gets a job, services or a consequence. A person decides.
being_open: Label teaching materials made with AI.
Answer funders honestly when they ask about AI, including in grant writing.
Donor letters need no AI label if a person signed and meant them.
if_something_goes_wrong: Tell Luis and Grace the same day. If client data is involved, Grace decides if it is a breach under the county contract.
Reporting a mistake is expected. No one is punished for it.
who_owns_this: The board approves this policy and any changes.
Everyone gets an hour of training, not just an email.
open_questions: Which tools do we pay for or allow: ChatGPT Team, Copilot for everyone, teachers' ChatGPT, or Canva AI images?
Can AI help with case notes or county and funder reports, and who approves it?
Can AI score the intake essay for class placement?
Who owns this policy day to day?
